capabilities: OAuth 2.1 authorization-code with PKCE, metadata discovery, dynamic registration, loopback callback, refresh tokens and DPAPI-encrypted tokens for remote MCP
read_image accepts one 1-based PDF page rasterized by checksum-pinned PDFium and one video frame at a second offset extracted by the optional FFmpeg component
rendered frames are cached as DPAPI-encrypted bounded files; source changes invalidate them and image bytes never enter the task journal
opt-in Windows AppContainer sandbox for approved commands: no capabilities, no network, no user-file access, writes only inside the configured workspace
opt-in per-server AppContainer sandbox for local stdio MCP servers with inherited stdio and the shared JSON-RPC/approval pipeline
explicit sandbox/unsandboxed labeling in tool results and settings; no silent fallback when sandbox launch fails
securityBoundaries: all external actions remain default-off or explicitly approved; external and sandboxed results are untrusted evidence
AppContainer requires ACL-grantable program files; system-installed runtimes may refuse and are never bypassed
OAuth supports authorization-code + PKCE + dynamic registration only; no device-code or enterprise SSO in this version
no whole-document/video indexing, no VM-level isolation, no cross-platform or cloud sync
